hysplit.README.txt:
HYSPLIT cross-check for this scenario
Meteorology for past dates: download gdas1.nov26.w4 from https://www.ready.noaa.gov/data/archives/gdas1/ into this folder (or a finer ARL archive such as gfs0p25, nam12 or hrrr, and edit CONTROL's met lines). Archive files exist only after the fact; for a forecast, use NOAA ARL forecast meteorology (https://www.ready.noaa.gov/data/forecast/) and set CONTROL's met lines to it.
Run: hycs_std   (reads CONTROL and SETUP.CFG here, writes cdump)
Output: concentration in kg/m3 averaged over 0-100 m, hourly; deposition in kg/m2.
Online alternative: NOAA READY HYSPLIT (ready.noaa.gov) with the same start, location, heights and particle sizes.

sites.name: EPA sampling sites
sites.note: EPA's preliminary data as posted, saved Nov. 28, 2026, 9:05 a.m. CST. Only the four continuous lead monitors post results. A reading near zero doesn't show whether a cloud missed the monitor or little lead got out. Measurements, not model estimates.

realtime.label: Air filter, with dust and gas monitors

arearae.name: AreaRAE
arearae.text: A wireless monitor for up to seven hazards, including gamma radiation, volatile organic compounds, combustible and toxic gases, and oxygen (Honeywell).

cassette.name: Air cassette
cassette.text: A filter that collects particles from the air. A lab measures the lead on it.

limit.label: the Army's lead air sampling method, from its 3 p.m. maps of Nov. 25 (McFate 2026d)

dusttrak.name: DustTrak
dusttrak.text: A light-scattering laser photometer that gives real-time readings of the mass of particles in the air (TSI).

soil.name: Soil sample
soil.text: EPA lists where and when it started sampling soil.

summa.name: Summa canister
summa.text: A specially prepared stainless steel canister that takes in a sample of air for a lab to test for volatile organic compounds (EPA Method TO-15).

xact.name: Xact continuous lead monitor
xact.text: Collects particles from the air on a filter tape and measures their metals by X-ray fluorescence as it runs, so its readings post without a lab. EPA hasn't published the model, inlet size or detection limit.
